resolutions: Sync bypassed Gerrit review: execution now opens the review dialog, and Sync is removed from both palettes.
Partial-clone history readers bypassed consent: the entire clone-options feature is excluded.
Gerrit amend discarded sign-off and bypassed SkipHooks: delayed preparation preserves original argv and hooks recognize the marker offset.
Gerrit push lost its skip-hooks flag before confirmation: the dialog now owns that choice and confirmed push retains it.

checks: All round-one findings resolved on the pinned final candidate.
Structural stale-result ownership and staging guards reviewed.
Graph interactions and theme changes reviewed.
Bundle create-only atomic ref transactions, immutable-byte reparse, no-lazy prerequisite verification, object fsck and checked-out/unborn guards reviewed.
Independently exercised installed Difftastic 0.72.0 with the exact external-diff protocol/flags on rewrapped Unicode Rust; byte spans and changed tokens matched.
limitations: Reviewer did not run Cargo or CI.
Native Windows and live SSH/WSL runtime behavior unverified.
